sourceRef.title: Why Four Eyes Check Is Dangerous

sentences.text: We get fatigued, distracted, and complacent.

sourceRef.title: Why Four Eyes Check Is Dangerous

sentences.text: We're influenced by relationships, pressure, and cognitive biases.

sourceRef.title: Why Four Eyes Check Is Dangerous

sentences.text: But we're excellent at judgment calls, creative problem-solving, and handling novel situations.↵Effective controls leverage automation for what machines do well and reserve human judgment for what humans do well:

sourceRef.title: Why Four Eyes Check Is Dangerous

sentences.text: Automated validation provides consistent, tireless enforcement of rules that humans struggle to apply reliably.

sourceRef.title: Why Four Eyes Check Is Dangerous

sentences.text: More importantly, automated controls improve continuously as policies evolve and new threats emerge.↵**Business Rule Enforcement**: Systems validate transactions against business rules automatically.

sourceRef.title: Why Four Eyes Check Is Dangerous

sentences.text: Invalid transactions get rejected before human review.

sourceRef.title: Why Four Eyes Check Is Dangerous

sentences.text: Humans review exceptions, not routine transactions.

sourceRef.title: Why Four Eyes Check Is Dangerous

sentences.text: As compliance requirements change, rules get updated in code and immediately apply to all transactions.
